client_id.description: Help Scout OAuth2 application client id, used for the client-credentials token exchange. Never logged.

client_secret.description: Help Scout OAuth2 application client secret, used for the client-credentials token exchange. Never logged.

base_url.description: Help Scout Mailbox API base URL override for tests or proxies.

token_url.description: Help Scout OAuth2 token endpoint override for tests or proxies.

start_date.description: RFC3339 lower bound; sent as modifiedSince to scope conversations/customers to records changed at or after this time.

conversationid.description: Help Scout conversation id that scopes the conversations_threads stream; supplied per read with --conversation-id.

customerid.description: Help Scout customer id that scopes the customers_chats, customers_emails, customers_phones, customers_social_profiles, and customers_websites streams; supplied per read with --customer-id.

mailboxid.description: Help Scout mailbox id that scopes the mailboxes_fields, mailboxes_folders, and mailboxes_saved_replies streams; supplied per read with --mailbox-id.

organizationid.description: Help Scout organization id that scopes the organizations_conversations and organizations_customers streams; supplied per read with --organization-id.

teamid.description: Help Scout team id that scopes the teams_members stream; supplied per read with --team-id.
